address: C. 24 Sur 703, Azcarate, Heróica Puebla de Zaragoza, 72501, Mexico
bio: This colorful taqueria can do it all. Away from the historic center and close to the ecological park, this quiet spot has a small but focused menu that delivers wonderful tacos made with soft, plush, flatbread-like pan árabe. Both the tacos arabe and taco pastor variations are worth trying, each one waiting to be dressed up with a fiery salsa. Not to be missed are the excellent cemitas, which arrive hot, toasted and filled with melty queso. A side bowl of charred, sweet onions is a nice touch to any bite.
